message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present on incoming data; the code only sets up argparse arguments and environment/utility functions without validating data structure or content.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; data appears to be loaded from local paths with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authenticated source handling.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code references model loading via '--load' and '--load-model-dir' arguments but contains no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls before loading serialized model weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code validates label distribution, checks class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (ARI, F1, rand index) are computed, there is no evidence of held-out set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other explicit protections against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection are visible in the inference data-flow path; data is read and used directly via get_data/deploy without validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model outputs are present in the visible inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision segmentation pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
